claim: Soča Splash Bovec 2026 prices: half-day rafting €59–62, full-day rafting with picnic €120–130, Sušec canyoning €65–70, Fratarica canyoning €105–115, kayak course €82–84, zip line €70, climbing/caving €75.

claim: Kayak Soča runs a Bovec-based kayak school with multi-day beginner-to-intermediate courses on the upper Soča.
